cards.title: Bethesda Premier Cup
cards.roomDemandNote: Official stay-to-play housing program via HBC Event Services. Housing-program status is not a peak-room count.
cards.destinationStatus: Multi-site DMV fields (not Bethesda-centered): Alexandria VA (U9–U12); Poolesville; Olney; Liberty Park Upper Marlboro (U15 boys); Maryland SoccerPlex Boyds (U16–U19)
cards.eventLocationSummary: Multi-site DMV tournament fields — not a single Bethesda venue. Confirm age-group field locations before treating Bethesda Marriott as in-footprint lodging.
cards.whatWeKnow: Bethesda Soccer Club hosts Bethesda Premier Cup (2026-11-13 – 2026-11-22) across multi-site DMV fields. HBC Event Services runs the official stay-to-play housing program.
cards.whyFits: Local Bethesda identity and inventory can matter for teams whose fields are within a commercially reasonable drive of Bethesda Marriott — only if the hotel is on the official HBC list for those age groups. Multi-site geography means Bethesda is not automatically the right lodging node for every division.
cards.whyMatters: Housing is controlled through HBC; participation depends on list inclusion, not on club name alone.
cards.whyNow: Tournament dates are public for November 2026; confirm whether Bethesda Marriott is on the HBC housing set before blocks allocate.
cards.limitations: Housing-program evidence alone does not prove peak rooms, confirmed overflow at this hotel, or an open buying mandate. Field locations vary by age group.
cards.nextAction: Ask HBC Event Services whether Bethesda Marriott is on the 2026 housing list for age groups whose fields are near Bethesda, and what peak-room pattern to expect.
